description: This file defines a custom validation annotation @FieldMatch used to ensure two fields in a Java class have matching values, typically used for password or email confirmation fields. It includes the annotation definition, its parameters, and a nested annotation for applying multiple constraints.

classes.name: FieldMatch
classes.description: A custom validation annotation to compare two fields within a Java class and verify they match.

classes.name: FieldMatch.List
classes.description: Nested annotation allowing multiple @FieldMatch annotations to be applied on the same element.

methods.name: message
methods.description: Returns the default validation error message if fields do not match.

methods.name: groups
methods.description: Returns the groups to which this constraint belongs.

methods.name: payload
methods.description: Returns any payload associated with this constraint.

methods.name: first
methods.description: Returns the name of the first field to compare.

methods.name: second
methods.description: Returns the name of the second field to compare.
